opening.argument: The offer is built around purchasable mining packages, with options priced from $500 to $3,500, and it is promoted as a source of daily passive income. The speaker says it is “earning a residual passive income that pays you daily,” while also explaining that compensation is based on a binary tree: “15 credits left and 15 credits right equals one cycle and one cycle is 200 dollars worth of bitcoin.” Together, the package sales and team-credit payment structure support the conclusion that this is a deceptive financial solicitation tied to paid mining or node returns. The claimed earnings of nearly $7,000 in 30 days from an approximately $2,709 deposit are not independently verified by these records, which also do not establish that any payout occurred.
